entities.summary: "Dans un autre monde" is a song by Canadian singer Celine Dion from her sixteenth studio album, S'il suffisait d'aimer (1998). It was written by Jean-Jacques Goldman and produced by Goldman and Erick Benzi. A live performance video was released in August 1999 to promote the album Au cœur du stade.
